//#region src/greeting.txt?raw
const greeting_default = "hello from vite\n";

//#endregion
//#region \0virtual:cloudflare/worker-entry
const worker_entry_default = {
  async fetch(request) {
    const { pathname } = new URL(request.url);

    if (pathname === "/api/greeting") {
      return Response.json({ greeting: greeting_default.trim() });
    }
    if (pathname === "/api/phase1-boom") {
      throw new Error("phase1-boom-testtoken");
    }
    return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
  },
};

//#endregion
export { worker_entry_default as default };
